this depends on what mbti means to youthe mbti test that you take and which has been studied academically in actual scientific papers is to my knowledge regarded as simply an incomplete basis on a subspace of human personality in this picture the space of behavioral human personality is basically a 5d space and the mbti is some 4d subset of that this is the dichotomy based ie ns tf and jp the reason mbti is out of favor is because those letters have correlations with one another perhaps being more n is more likely to make you f or some such thing they mbti dichotomies not mutually independent additionally they lack in describing neuroticism which means your mbti type fails to predict behavior that other personality tests could detectso what happens if you give the mbti along with a bunch of other personality tests and then try to find the groupings of questions that result in 1 mutual independence and 2 a complete coverage of the academically important read predictive factors what youre effectively doing is called dimensionality reduction or principal component analysis and it results in the big 5 personality scale in big 5 the major human personality traits are mutually independent and as predictive as the previous tests including mbti so in this respect the mbti test is obsolete its not a bad test as such but the big 5 basically subsumes it by the way this is why 16personalities adds the assertiveturbulent dichotomy so they can bring their test to at least cover the same space as the big 5 even if not quite as cleanlymbti itself was originally a proxy invented to attempt to discover the relative important of jungs cognitive functions however its taken on a life of its own and the dichotomy based result is what ended up being used academically before it was superseded the simple dichotomy based mbti test itself ends up being the same thing as the big 5 only worse in actual usefulness in this picture your mbti code is the fundamental result any underlying theory does not existthe theory that the test was originally supposed to be a proxy for is in the eyes of jungian typologists more fundamental unlike the purely final resultoriented academic tests it tries to serve as a model for how human personality gets to be the way it is which is an angle thats inherently more interesting to a lot people because it answers many more why and how questions in addition to serving as something of a roadmap for selfimprovement and selfawareness if mbti means this more fundamental model then the test is merely measuring the final results of your underlying functions and extrapolating back to the underlying functions stack but the result on the test does not define your type nor is it fundamental to jungians and the way that it is supposed to connect back to your underlying functions is perhaps questionableput another way neither the speed you see on your speedometer nor the force of the wind on your hand as you put it out the window nor the radar reading from the cop as he pulls you over are your speed they dont define your speed your speed is the magnitude of your position change with respect to time but you can measure it in multiple ways all of which are merely an approximate indication as to what your speed is and all of which must be connected back to your speed by some argument or theoryconclusiontldr so if the mbti is the four letter code returned by the test for you then you treat that result as fundamental and are not in a position to discuss cognitive functions in fact youd be much better served by the big 5 and theres a lot of interesting research connected to itotherwise if the mbti is instead supposed to represent your functions then given that the test is only tenuously linked to what your
